name: Operator Collusion (Quorum Attack)
summary: Two compromised operators (alpha, beta) publish matching OperatorVerdict@1 marking a benign swap as 'confirmed'. Federation is 3-of-4, so quorum is not reached — defense does not fire.
expectedOutcome: OperatorVerdicts appear on sentinel.detection.operator.{alpha,beta}. Federation aggregator counts K=2 against N=4, below threshold K=3. No ThreatConfirmedEvent@2. Alert emitted flagging suspicious operator coordination.

steps.text: Operators alpha + beta flag the same benign swap as CONFIRMED (10000 bp)
Aggregator: 2 confirmations vs. quorum K=3 — below threshold
No defense triggered. Quorum held the line against two bad actors.
Alert: operators alpha + beta flagged for review.
